desc: A small café with pale wooden walls. A young woman with long red curly hair in a blue top tips a big glass jar full of copper coins onto the wooden counter, and the small coins pour out into a pile. Behind the counter a white goat in a green apron stands on its hind legs holding a wooden spatula, looks at the pile and then turns to her, and she smiles at it. A paper coffee cup, cinnamon buns under a glass dome, a coffee machine, mugs on a shelf and a plant are around them.

desc: In a bright bedroom in the morning, a young woman in a long light-blue shirt and socks laughs as she flings a white sheet high into the air over a wooden bed, and a ginger cat leaps through the air under the billowing sheet. desc: A misty river at dawn with low sun through the willows. A rowing eight comes straight at the camera; the woman at the front, in a navy cap with a headset microphone at her mouth, shouts calls at the crew behind her, her mouth wide open. The rowers drive through the stroke in time with her, the boat surging and throwing spray off the blades. At the end the crew punch their fists up together.
